name: What are the benefits of hiring a dedicated architect coordinator versus relying on the general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of hiring a dedicated architect coordinator versus relying on the general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: While a general contractor manages the overall construction, a dedicated architect coordinator specializes in bridging the gap between design and construction. This specialized role ensures that the architectural vision is meticulously executed, and complex design details are fully understood by all trades. A key benefit is having an advocate solely focused on design integrity, which can prevent compromises that might occur when a general contractor's primary focus is on construction efficiency and budget, a common practical tradeoff.
acceptedAnswer.description: A dedicated architect coordinator ensures meticulous design execution and acts as a design advocate, unlike a general contractor whose focus is broader construction management.
